senses.gloss: f. pl.(b. h. חֲבִתִּים; חבת, cmp. חבץ, חָבִיץ) a sort of cakes (cmp. מַחֲבַת).
units: Y. Yoma I, beg. 38ᵃ נאמר תמיד בח׳ the word tamid is used in connection with ḥăbittin (Lev. VI, 13).
<cite ref="Leviticus 6:13">Ib.</cite> <he>אין ח׳ מעכבת</he> (sub. <he>הקרבת</he>) the offering of the cakes at the Highpriest’s inauguration is no indispensable requirement.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 11:3">Men. XI, 3</cite> <he>חֲבִיתֵּי כ״ג</he> the cakes at the Highpriest’s inauguration.
